title: Raw stage restriction as a filtered colimit of stage sheaves
statement: Let $J$ be a small filtered category, $F:J\to\mathrm{Cat}$ a diagram of small categories, and $V$ a cocone with vertex $C$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $P_j$ and $Q$ be precoverages on $F(j)$ and $C$. Every transition functor $F(a)$ and cocone functor $V_j$ is continuous for the generated topologies [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Fix $i\in J$ and a set-valued sheaf $G$ on $P_i$. Write $I=\mathrm{Under}(i)$, $A_t=F(t.hom)_sG$. For $b:t\to t'$ give a sheaf map $\theta_b:A_t\to F(b.right)^s A_{t'}$ whose composite with the unit $G\to F(t.hom)^s A_t$ equals the unit at $t'$ componentwise as objects of the arrow category of sets. For $t\in I$ let $B_t$ be a presheaf on $C$, with $\beta_t:A_t\to V_t^p B_t$ exhibiting $B_t$ as the left Kan extension of the underlying presheaf of $A_t$ along $V_t^{op}$. Here $V_t=V_{t.right}$, $V_t^p$ is presheaf restriction, and a left Kan extension means that composition with $\beta_t$ bijects maps $B_t\to T$ with maps $A_t\to V_t^p T$ for every presheaf $T$. Let $B:I\to\mathrm{PSh}(C)$ have these objects and satisfy, for all $b:t\to t'$ and $X\in F(t.right)$, $\beta_t(X)B(b)(V_tX)=\theta_b(X)\beta_{t'}(F(b.right)X)$ as objects of $\mathrm{Arrow}(\mathrm{Set})$.Assume the object and arrow cocones of $V$ are set colimits [def-weil-pbc-arrows-functor]. No covering finiteness or pullback-preservation assumption is imposed. For every $j\in J$, there exist $k\in J$, $a:i\to k$, $b:j\to k$, and a diagram $D:\mathrm{Under}(k)\to\mathrm{Sh}(P_j;\mathrm{Sets})$ such that the presheaf colimit of the underlying presheaves of $D$ is isomorphic to $V_j^{op}\circ\mathrm{colim}\,B$. For every $t=(k\to l)$, the sheaf $D(t)$ is isomorphic to $F(b\circ t)^s(F(a\circ t)_sG)$, where $b\circ t$ and $a\circ t$ mean first $b$ or $a$, then $t$. Thus the restriction of the raw Kan colimit is a filtered colimit of explicitly specified stage sheaves; no separatedness, amalgamation or sheafness of that colimit is asserted.

proof.text: Choose a common stage k receiving i and j, with arrows a and b. For t in Under k define D(t) by pulling G along a followed by t.hom and pushing it to stage j along b followed by t.hom. Continuity makes this a sheaf on stage j. Use the adjunction transpose of the unit for each transition; adjunction uniqueness proves identity and composition. The componentwise unit condition htheta identifies this transition with the supplied theta after the functor composition isomorphisms. Under k is filtered by the dual of the cofiltered-over-category assertion.

proof.text: For each object U of stage j, compose the Kan unit beta at the image of U with the outer colimit coprojection, transporting the target along the cocone equality to V(j)(U). Naturality of beta and hbeta_map make this a compatible cocone in t, natural in U. This defines a comparison from the presheaf colimit of the underlying D to the raw presheaf restricted along V(j).

proof.text: Compute each raw B value by its pointwise Kan presentation. A generator is a stage section and an arrow from V(j)(U) to a stage image. Represent the arrow in the given arrow-set colimit. Refine to equate both endpoints with the desired object representatives using the given object-set colimit; take a common stage receiving k and the generator stage, and equalize arrows out of k. Restrict the transported section along this lifted arrow. The resulting D representative maps to the original generator, proving surjectivity. For injectivity, an equality is a finite chain of Kan and outer-colimit relations. Lift its finitely many arrows and equations to a single later stage by the same set-colimit equality criterion. Naturality and hbeta_map identify every relation there with restriction or transition in D; consequently the two D classes agree. These pointwise bijections are natural, hence are a presheaf isomorphism. The stated object isomorphisms hold by construction of D.

theorem colimit_site_raw_stage_restriction
    (J : Type u) [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J] (F : J ⥤ Cat.{u, u})
    (P : ∀ j : J, Precoverage (F.obj j))
    [∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k),
      (F.map a).toFunctor.IsContinuous (P j).toGrothendieck (P k).toGrothendieck]
    (V : Cocone F)
    (hobjects : IsColimit (Cat.objects.mapCocone V))
    (harrows : IsColimit (Cat.arrows.mapCocone V))
    (Q : Precoverage V.pt)
    [∀ j : J, (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.IsContinuous
      (P j).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck]
    (i : J) (G : Sheaf (P i).toGrothendieck (Type u))
    (θ : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t'),
                        (sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
                          (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G ⟶
                        ((F.map b.right).toFunctor.sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type u)
                          (P t.right).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck).obj
                          ((sheafPullback (F.map t'.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
                            (P i).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck).obj G))
    (hθ : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t'),
      (∀ X : F.obj i,
                          Arrow.mk
                            (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (F.map t.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
                              (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).unit.app
                                G).hom.app (op X) ≫
                              (θ t t' b).hom.app (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj X))) =
                          Arrow.mk
                            (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (F.map t'.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
                              (P i).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck).unit.app
                                G).hom.app (op X))))
    (B : Under i ⥤ (V.ptᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u))
    (β : ∀ t : Under i,
      ((sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
        (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G).obj ⟶
        (V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.op ⋙ B.obj t)
    (hβ : ∀ t : Under i, (B.obj t).IsLeftKanExtension (β t))
    (hβmap : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t') (X : F.obj t.right),
      Arrow.mk ((β t).app (op X) ≫
        (B.map b).app (op ((V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.obj X))) =
      Arrow.mk ((θ t t' b).hom.app (op X) ≫
        (β t').app (op ((F.map b.right).toFunctor.obj X))))
    (j : J) :
    ∃ (k : J) (a : i ⟶ k) (b : j ⟶ k)
      (D : Under k ⥤ Sheaf (P j).toGrothendieck (Type u)),
      Nonempty (colimit (D ⋙ sheafToPresheaf (P j).toGrothendieck (Type u)) ≅
        (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.op ⋙ colimit B) ∧
      ∀ t : Under k, Nonempty (D.obj t ≅
        ((F.map (b ≫ t.hom)).toFunctor.sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type u)
          (P j).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj
          ((sheafPullback (F.map (a ≫ t.hom)).toFunctor (Type u)
            (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G))
